title: Drag as command board closeout
body: Implemented global board drag interactions as command-backed transitions. Dragging a ready card to In Progress posts work.reserve against the owning project workspace, dragging in-progress back to Ready posts work.release, and dragging a non-terminal card to Closed posts work.close with a reason prompt. The UI does not optimistically move cards; success reloads the rollup and failure renders a refusal panel with preserved gate gaps, recovery commands, and directive command data. Derived-only columns are marked non-droppable. Validation: focused console tests passed and pnpm check passed. Git checkpoint: 0412cd33.
